description: Sets the authenticated user's currently active task. Updates the user's presence so managers see what task the employee is working on. Use when the user says 'I am working on task X', 'set my active task', 'select task', or 'switch to task Y'. WARNING: This is a write tool — it updates the user's presence record. Always confirm the task_id before calling. Requires TaskManagement feature. Disabled in demo mode. Requires mcp:write scope for OAuth tokens.

task_id.description: UUID of the task to set as active. Use list_my_tasks to find task IDs. Required.

name: select_task
title: Select Active Task
